#BrotherhoodOfTheKestrel (7.30 MB)
BROTHERHOOD OF THE KESTREL (version 1.0) This much anticipated follow-up to the popular EMPIRE OF CRIME also takes place during the savage conflict between the hegemony of the Terran Star Empire and the rebellious Weave Alliance. Fighting has reached a critical point with either side poised for victory, though as manpower and resources are increasingly redirected to the front lines, organised crime has achieved unprecedented power in the absence of any serious law enforcement. Tiring of the increasingly dangerous life of a Consolidated Express bridge officer, you have resigned your commission and left the world of legitimate business behind to forge your own path to wealth and glory. The game thus charts the exploits of three of the galaxy's most dangerous pirate guilds: the savage and homocidal band of assassins and cutthroats that make up the Darkside Faction the ruthless Sauridian criminal juggernaut known as the K'rali Syndicate and master pirate Carl Warrington's devious Subnebula Cartel. Big guns, bad attitudes, hidden agendas and twice the action of the original conspire to make this an absolute must-have for the hardcore player. The plug boasts scores of new systems and planets to explore, devastating new faction specific warships and weaponry and many new and altered ships, including several formidable bosses. There are THREE different character driven storylines in 220 brand new, original missions that feature numerous interacting personalities and factions. WARNING: MATURE PLAYERS ONLY. This game contains graphic descriptive violence, profanity and adult themes that some may find offensive. The plug was compressed using DropStuff 6.0 and the author can be contacted via www.evula.org/empire_trilogy.

(version 2.0) This is the plug-in that started it all! As outlined previously, it centers on the conflict between the oppressive Terran Star Empire and a ragtag group of aliens known as The Weave who have formed a temporary alliance to fight off Empire annexation. You can fly for these rebels, the Empire or even organised crime if you prefer. There are 30 new ships, 48 new weapons/outfits and about 100 new missions. The plug-in comes complete with an extended stand-alone document which gives greater detail as to the storyline and factions. #EmpireOfCrime (3.20 MB)
EMPIRE OF CRIME (version 1.0) The war between the rebellious Weave Alliance and the hegemony of the Terran Star Empire has reached a critical point, with either side poised for victory. However, as resources are increasingly seconded to the front lines, the only true victor has been intergalactic organised crime, which has profited and risen to infamy in the absence of any real law enforcement. Tiring of the increasingly dangerous life of a merchant trader, you decide to abandon the world of legitimate business and forge your own path to glory. The game can be played from the viewpoint of three very different perspectives: an association with the upstart Serpens Triumvirate the thankless task of an intergalactic bounty hunter, or an allegiance with the mysterious Mafia. This will be a galaxy in which you will have a multitude of enemies and precious few friends... though who can you really trust, for in a time of near anarchy and golden opportunity, friendship and comradery are the rarest of all commodities. This plug offers more than 200 original missions, a multitude of new weapons and outfits, over 100 new worlds and systems and more than 40 new and altered ships, including seven formidable "bosses". Indeed, this plug-in should prove to be an absolute must-have for the 'hardcore' EV player. In this instalment, the oppressive Terran Star Empire controls the galaxy with an iron fist. Forced into retreat, surrounded and fighting for its very survival, the rebellious Weave Alliance has been quietly establishing relations with the Saa'rel Union, a pacifist society of remarkable technological prowess. Efforts are being made by The Weave to convince the Saa'rellians of the very real danger posed by Empire annexation, and perhaps gain a much needed ally in return. Realising the possible threat of any such union and encouraged by the discovery of a mysterious artifact, the Empire's dark agents are secretly attempting to make first contact with a mythical, ancient race of unimaginable power with the intention of forming an alliance of its own, thus countering any possible future Weave insurgency. However, little does the Empire's fanatical Central Command realise what they are about to unleash on an unsuspecting - and unprepared - universe. This plug-in offers 62 unique new outfits,48 new and altered ships, with 3 powerful "bosses" and 2 deadly sentinels, 70 new systems and 75 new stellars to explore and two decidedly different character storylines to play via 220 original, well written missions. I have been playing EV for a long time. I had finally achieved my final goal...I received the "Investigate Disappearances" mission. It was for the Confeds. I went through the cycle of missions, but couldn't destroy the alien cruiser. So, I cheated, using my home-made "Fusion Beam" to mutilate the alien bastards. Triumphant, I sold my Fusion Beam and returned to Mars, thus gaining the ability to buy Confed ships on Luna. Later, I flew to Palshife. To my surprise, I found that I could also buy Rebel ships there. I figured that there was some small bug. Then, I went to the bar...and was offered the "Investigate Disappearances" mission by the Rebels! Now, I realized, here was a stupid mistake, not just some small bug. I accepted anyway, and finished the mission. Then, I was offered the "Lead Rebel Patrol" mission, and found a missing period and another stupid mistake in the intro text. I hate bad grammar - it really diminishes from the play experience. So, I decided to make this plug-in "patch." It fixes all of those things.
